paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend. The people were hungry and tired, and they spoke against God and against Moses (Numbers 21:5). Then the snakes came, and the people said, "We have sinned by speaking against the LORD and against you." (Numbers 21:7). That's the turn, because they stopped arguing and started owning it.

Now look at what the LORD gave them. He told Moses, "When anyone who is bitten looks at it, he will live." (Numbers 21:8). Nobody had to fix themselves first or climb the pole, they just had to look. I think that's the part we miss, because we want a to-do list and God hands us a pole.

So here's what I want you to carry out of my bakery today. When you've messed up, say it plainly and look to the One God provides. I spent years in a junk drawer sure I'd run out my own clock, and I'm telling you, looking up beats hiding every single time. Run to Him FAST, friend, with your whole mess in your hands.
